composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114a, "BILGE SYSTEM") serves the bilge subsystem equipment: the Main Bilge Pump (top-left motor circuit fed via F3 60A/SW8), the six motorised Bilge Valves feeding each named zone bilge (Port Lazarette, Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng. Room, Fwd, Sail Locker), the corresponding bilge level switches per zone, and the Vessel Control Panel (Main Panel + PC Card) that displays open/closed valve status and drives the bilge pump switch. Evidence: title block says "BILGE SYSTEM"; each valve controller block is explicitly captioned "BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE" (generic caption reused per row) with the zone name printed beside the level switch (PORT LAZARETTE BILGE, STBD LAZARETTE BILGE, AFT BILGE, ENG. ROOM BILGE, FWD BILGE, SAIL LOCKER); the relay bank/terminal strips (T/S B, T/S C) and PLUG C/PLUG D interface into "MAIN PANEL" and "MAIN PANEL PC CARD" boxes explicitly labelled as such, matching engineer mapping BILGE VALVES -> 520-bilge-valves and MAIN PANEL -> 641-vessel-control-panel. The Main Bilge Pump motor at top is separately fed from F3 60A and matches established fact for 520-main-bilge-pump (fuse F7 60A on another sheet; this sheet shows a local F3 60A/SW8/SO6 branch feeding the same motor symbol, treated as the same pump equipment node with its own local control loop). No node exists for individual level switches or the PC card enclosure itself as separate equipment — these are composed as key components/infrastructure of the valve and panel nodes respectively.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Top-of-sheet motor symbol explicitly labelled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP', matching engineer mapping BILGE PUMP -> 520-main-bilge-pump. Fed via its own F3 60A fuse/SW8 switch/SO6 solenoid-overload branch, separate from the local pump switch loop routed through T/S S.

functions.label: Main bilge pump power feed and local start switch
functions.what_it_does: Provides +24V power to the main bilge pump motor and allows local start/stop via a dedicated local pump switch wired through terminal strip T/S S.

flow_scenarios.path: +24V service battery bus -> F3 60A fuse -> SW8 switch (open) -> SO 6 device -> pump motor circuit de-energised
+24V service battery bus -> F3 60A fuse -> SW8 switch (closed) -> SO 6 -> terminal strip T/S S (terminals 13,14,15) -> LOCAL PUMP SW contact -> pump motor energised, pump runs

functions.dry_data: Fed via fuse F3, 60A; local switch SW8; SO 6 device inline; local pump switch on T/S S terminals 13-15.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Each of the six valve controller blocks is captioned 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE' (a repeated generic caption applying to the device symbol below/beside it) and is wired with OPEN/CLOSE contacts driving a motorised valve [2]/[3] terminals; matches engineer mapping BILGE VALVES -> 520-bilge-valves. Each valve serves one named bilge zone as printed beside its level switch (Port/Stbd Lazarette combined, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) and is commanded from relays Re1-Re5 via terminal strip T/S C, with status reported to Main Panel PLUG C / PC Card.

functions.label: Port/Stbd Lazarette bilge valve open/close control
functions.what_it_does: Opens or closes the motorised bilge valve routing the Port and Stbd Lazarette bilge level-switch signals into the bilge monitoring/pump-call loop; relay Re1 selects which lazarette bilge switch feeds the loop.

flow_scenarios.path: Port Lazarette Bilge SW and Stbd Lazarette Bilge SW (level switches) -> wired to bilge valve motor terminals via T/S C terminals 7-13 -> relay Re1 (fed from Bilge Valves breaker Q13 10A via T/S B terminal 8) -> valve holds last commanded position
OPEN switch contact -> T/S C terminal 7/1 -> valve motor terminal [2] -> valve opens, admitting lazarette bilge flow path to common bilge line
CLOSE switch contact -> T/S C terminal 8/2 -> valve motor terminal [3] -> valve closes, isolating lazarette bilge line
valve/level-switch loop -> T/S C terminals 12/13 -> XA40 taps 14/12 -> monitoring loom (status signal, direction into monitoring per drawn taps)

functions.dry_data: Motor-actuated valve with OPEN/CLOSE contact pair, commanded via relay Re1 fed from Bilge Valves breaker Q13 10A through T/S B terminal 8 and T/S C terminals 1-15; wire-gauge diamond callouts on T/S C wires (12,13) are gauge marks, not devices.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Vessel Control Panel (Main Panel + PC Card) — bilge indication/control
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The sheet's own boxes are titled 'MAIN PANEL' and 'MAIN PANEL PC CARD' with PLUG C / PLUG D interconnects, matching engineer mapping MAIN PANEL -> 641-vessel-control-panel. This panel receives the open/closed status of each of the five monitored bilge valves (Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) and hosts the bilge pump start switch S13 and pedestal alarm/mute module.

functions.label: Bilge valve position indication (open/closed lamps) on PC Card
functions.what_it_does: Displays open/closed status for each of the five bilge valve zones (Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) using circled-X indicator lamps on the PC Card, driven by a +24V diode array fed from PLUG D via PLUG C.

flow_scenarios.path: Bilge valve loops (via T/S C terminals and XA40/XA10 taps) -> PLUG C pins 1-5 (Lazarette=1, Aft=2, Eng.Room=3, Fwd=4, Sail Locker=5) -> PLUG D pins 1-10 -> Main Panel PC Card diode array (+24V) -> open/closed circled-X lamps per zone
AUX PLUG on PC board pins [8]->>[1], [9]->>[2], [10]->>[3], [11]->>[4] -> feeds corresponding PLUG C pins 1-4 as auxiliary source/status link

functions.dry_data: PC Card indicator array: 10 circled-X lamps (open/closed pairs for 5 zones), +24V supply, diode array for isolation; PLUG C 7-pin, PLUG D 12-pin interconnects.

functions.label: Main Panel bilge pump start switch
functions.what_it_does: Provides a panel-mounted switch (S13, labelled BILGE PUMP SW) allowing the pump to be started/monitored from the main panel, separate from the local pump switch on T/S S.

flow_scenarios.path: Main Panel switch S13 (BILGE PUMP SW) -> panel wiring -> bilge pump control loop (link to main bilge pump motor circuit not fully traced beyond panel box on this sheet)

functions.dry_data: Switch S13 on Main Panel, labelled BILGE PUMP SW.

functions.label: Pedestal alarm and mute interface
functions.what_it_does: Provides an alarm sounder/mute module (ALARM MOD) at the helm pedestal, wired via a 12-terminal PLUG D style loom back to the Main Panel, for audible annunciation tied to the bilge/monitoring loop.

flow_scenarios.path: Main Panel wiring -> PEDESTAL ALARM+MUTE terminals 1-12 -> ALARM MOD (sounder + mute button) at pedestal

functions.dry_data: PEDESTAL ALARM+MUTE module, ALARM MOD device with mute pushbutton, 12-way terminal interconnect.

infrastructure.system_name: 24V Service Battery Distribution feeding this sheet
facts: Main bilge pump local branch fed via F3 60A fuse and SW8 switch from +24V SERVICE BAT. bus at top-left of sheet.
Bilge valves circuit fed via BILGE VALVES Q13 10A breaker from the same +24V SERVICE BAT. bus, feeding T/S B terminals 8-13 and relays Re1-Re6.
F2 200A appears as a bus-level protective device on the +24V SERVICE BAT. supply riser (main distribution fuse, not specific to bilge valves or pump).

infrastructure.system_name: Terminal strip / relay bank wiring infrastructure (T/S S, T/S B, T/S C)
facts: T/S S (3 terminals, 13-15) carries the local pump switch loop for the main bilge pump.
T/S B (terminals 8-13) distributes Bilge Valves breaker Q13 10A supply to relays Re1-Re6.

T/S C is a 50-terminal strip carrying OPEN/CLOSE commands and status taps for all five monitored bilge valve loops plus the Re6/ONYX loop; numbers in diamonds on T/S C wires (e.g. 12,13,21,22,29,30,37,38,45,46) are wire-gauge callouts, not devices.

uncertainties: T/S S relay/lamp wiring detail (contacts, 'LO' label, fuse-vs-terminal at position 15) is ambiguous in the extraction; exact local pump switch lamp/indicator behaviour could not be confidently resolved — treated as local start switch loop only.

The connection from Main Panel switch S13 (BILGE PUMP SW) onward to the actual main bilge pump motor circuit is not fully traced on this sheet — no drawn line confirms it joins the F3/SW8 branch; flagged rather than assumed.
PLUG C pins 6 and 7 and AUX PLUG pin 12 (AUX-12) have no clear destination label in the extraction — left uncomposed rather than guessed.
